consequence.statement: When updating to v2+, code bases that import crossplane or crossplane-runtime must update the module path and all import statements to the v2 module paths (github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2 and github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime/v2).
consequence.remediation: Update go.mod and all import statements from github.com/crossplane/crossplane and github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime to the /v2 module paths github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2 and github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime/v2 when updating to v2+.

assertion.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 updates the Go module path to github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2 (and crossplane-runtime to github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime/v2), so code bases that import crossplane or crossplane-runtime must update their module path and all import statements when updating to v2+.
